title: STR Operations Lead (Airbnb / Short-Term Rental)
description:
WavyStay is a Washington DC-based remote short-term rental co-hosting and property management company. Since 2021, we have managed 40–100+ properties across the US. We run a remote-first team with a Philippines-based virtual operations team, an AI-powered guest communication system, and a tech stack built around Hospitable,Slack, 
, GoHighLevel, and HostBuddy AI.



Our current Operations Lead is transitioning out of the role. We are looking for an experienced, self-directed STR operations professional to step in and own the day-to-day management of our guest services team.



This is one of the most important roles in our company. If you are organized, decisive, and have real experience managing remote teams in the short-term rental space, we want to hear from you.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Operations Lead is the backbone of WavyStay's daily execution. You sit between the CEO and the Customer Service team translating strategy into action, keeping the team accountable, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks across 40+ active properties.



You will not be doing daily guest messaging. We use HostBuddy AI for that. Your job is to make sure the team and the systems are running at the highest level every single day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



TEAM OVERSIGHT & SCHEDULING

- Own daily oversight of the CS team shift checklists and schedule adherence

- Ensure inbox coverage, phone line coverage, and calendar management are never gaps

- Monitor team performance in real time and flag issues before they become problems

- Run the weekly tea
eting keep it on agenda, on time, and action-oriented



PERFORMANCE & REPORTING

- Compile the weekly team KPI scorecard and deliver it to the CEO every Monday morning

- Track guest review scores, response times, open maintenance items, and claim resolution rates

- Identify performance trends and recommend corrections before they impact guest experience

- Maintain accountability logs for each tea
mber



AI SYSTEM MANAGEMENT

- Oversee HostBuddy AI configuration and message quality

- Spot-check AI responses daily and flag any responses that need human override

- Update AI knowledge base when property details, access codes, or house rules change

- Work with the CEO to optimize AI performance as the portfolio scales



VENDOR & CLEANING MANAGER RELATIONSHIPS

- Serve as the primary point of contact for cleaning managers (CMs) and maintenance manager 

- Conduct daily check-ins with CMs to confirm turnover completions and flag issues

- Coordinate urgent maintenance and repair requests across the portfolio

- Track vendor performance and escalate recurring issues



ESCALATION HANDLING

- Serve as the first escalation point for the CS team on operational blockers, system access issues, and coverage gaps

- Handle high-priority guest issues that require management-level intervention

- Coordinate AirCover and damage claim submissions alongside the Claims Manager

- Own resolution on any issue the CS team cannot resolve independently



TEAM DEVELOPMENT

- Conduct retraining when performance gaps are identified

- Issue corrective action when needed and recommend termination when warranted

- Onboard new CS team hires and ensure they are up to speed on SOPs before going live

- Maintain and update operational SOPs when recurring issues require process changes



WHAT YOU NEED



- 2–5 years of experience in STR operations, property management, or remote team management

- Direct experience with Airbnb, VRBO, Hospitable or a multi-listing STR management company

- Proven ability to manage a remote team across multiple time zones

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Experience with guest communication platforms (Hospitable, Guesty, OwnerRez, or similar)

- Comfortable working inside CRM and project management tools

- Highly organized with a bias toward documentation and systems

- Available 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST, Monday through Sunday with weekend availability for escalations ; Will have multiple days off throughout the week. 



BONUS POINTS

- Experience with HostBuddy AI, Hostpitable, 
 and GoHighLevel

- Prior experience managing 20+ STR listings simultaneously

- Background in team coaching, performance management, or CS quality auditing

- Experience handling Airbnb AirCover claims and damage disputes and airbnb resolutions 



COMPENSATION



Base salary: $600–$1,000/month USD depending on experience

Performance bonus tied to team KPI achievement

90-day review with raise potential

Long-term role we are building for scale and want someone who grows with us



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a template application. We will not read it.



To be considered, send all three of the following:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile link

2. A 2–3 minute video introduction  tell us who you are, the largest STR portfolio or team you have managed, and one specific example of a time you caught a problem before it became a guest complaint

3. Answer this question in writing: "It is Saturday morning at 9AM EST. Two cleaning managers have not confirmed their turnovers, one tea
mber called out sick, and a guest just messaged saying they cannot get into the property. Walk me through how you handle the next 30 minutes."



All three items are required. Missing any one means your application will not be reviewed.



This role requires someone who can hold the operation together when things get chaotic — and in STR, they always do. Show us how you think.



— The WavyStay Team

title: Senior Video Editor · Reels, Shorts & TikTok · CapCut Expert · Remote · Full-Time
description:
Ceartas is hiring a Senior Video Editor to own our short-form content engine. You'll edit 8-15 Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikToks per week for our founder and brand channels — cinematic, fast-paced, modern.



You're an editor first. Cuts, pacing, sound design, colour, motion. But you also stay close to trends — you watch what's working on social, you know which formats are exploding this week, and you bring ideas to the table when you spot one we should ride. Reports to the CEO and CMO.



- Edit 8-15 short-form videos per week (Reels, Shorts, TikTok, LinkedIn)

- Cut to a rhythm — beat-matched, hook-driven, no slack frames

- Grade Sony FX3A footage from S-Log3 to cinematic Rec.709 using LUTs

- Build text-behind-subject effects, kinetic typography, glow treatments

- Design auto-caption styles that match the Ceartas brand voice

- Source and sync trending audio (you spot it before it peaks)

- Mimic high-performing creator formats and adapt to our brand

- Pitch ideas when you spot a trend worth riding

- Manage your project pipeline in Notion or ClickUp

- Deliver final exports in correct specs per platform

- Iterate fast — feedback is direct, turnarounds are tight



Must-Have Editing Skills



- Expert-level CapCut Desktop AND Mobile (primary editors)

- Strong working knowledge of Final Cut Pro AND/OR DaVinci Resolve

- Deep understanding of LOG profiles and LUT workflows

  (S-Log3 ? Rec.709 conversion, stacking technical + creative LUTs)

- Smart Cutout / Subject Tracking / Text Behind Subject effects

- Auto-caption tools with custom brand styling

- Sound design: beat-matched cuts, SFX, music ducking

- Colour grading: HSL, curves, scopes, skin tone correction

- Export specs: H.264, HEVC, 10-bit, proper bitrates per platform

- Motion graphics basics — kinetic text, overlays, transitions

- Canva proficiency for thumbnails, overlays, and social assets



What Makes You Different (Beyond Editing)



- You scroll Reels and TikTok daily and treat it as research

- You can name top creators in any niche off the top of your head

- You watch a viral video and instantly clock why it worked

- You bring ideas to editing sessions — not just executing briefs

- You spot trends within 24-48 hours of them breaking

- You ship volume — a B+ shipped today beats an A+ shipped next week

- You're not precious — feedback is fast, blunt, and you adapt without ego



Must-Have Soft Skills



- Detail-obsessed and decisive — you spot frame-level errors others miss

- Outstanding eye for design and typography

- Flexible and resilient — handles fast turnarounds without losing quality

- Excellent communicator in written English (Slack, Loom, async)

- Self-directed — you don't need micromanagement

- Comfortable handling occasional adult-themed footage professionally

  (Ceartas operates in the creator-economy anti-piracy space)



Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote

- Working week: Wednesday to Sunday (weekends are core social windows)

- Some flexible / late hours during the first month for training

- Must overlap ~4 hours/day with Dubai timezone (GMT+4)

- Stable, reliable internet (50 Mbps+ minimum)

- Mac OS preferred (our studio is Mac-based)



What We Offer



- Fully remote

- 15 paid days off per year + public holidays + your birthday off + 13th month payment

- Company-paid health insurance (full coverage)

- Home equipment provided (Mac, monitor, peripherals as needed)

- Direct mentorship from the CEO

- A vibrant startup environment with a supportive, diverse team

- Employee recognition and reward program

- Inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and equal opportunity

- Growth path: this role can scale into Head of Content as we grow

- Real impact: your videos drive the growth of a Sony-backed brand



Portfolio Requirement (NON-NEGOTIABLE - DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT A PORTFOLIO)



We will not review applications without a portfolio. Résumés don't matter here — your work matters.



Submit:



1. A reel of your best short-form edits

2. At least ONE example of a video where you graded LOG/log-profile footage

3. At least ONE example with text-behind-subject, kinetic typography,

   or modern social effects

description:

The Mission As our Retention Specialist, you will be the "loyalty engine"—taking full ownership of the client lifecycle after the initial sign-on. You will monitor account health, identify potential churn before it happens, and ensure our clients feel prioritized and supported at every touchpoint. We need someone who prides themselves on turning challenges into long-term partnerships.



Your Day-to-Day Impact

* Retention Architecture: Beyond answering questions, you will manage client health logs and update engagement funnels to ensure every account is tracked with transparency and care.

* Strategic Success Planning: You will conduct "deep-dive" check-ins and account reviews, providing clear, actionable feedback to help our team improve the overall client experience.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Inside Sales Closer, Family Law
description:
Inside Sales Closer, Family Law (Remote)



Divorce With A Plan | Maryland-based, fully remote, US



We close hundreds of thousands of dollars in new client engagements every month. We are looking for one closer who can run our consult floor and push our conversion rate from 35% to 60% in 90 days.



This is not a BDR role. This is not intake. This is the closer.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Run 8 to 12 client consultations per week with people choosing a family law firm during one of the hardest decisions of their lives.

Convert 60% of those consultations into signed engagements averaging $14,000 per matter.

Sell across five service tiers ranging from $3,500 to $25,000 (uncontested divorce, contested divorce, custody, protective orders, child abuse).

Handle emotionally charged conversations with composure, professionalism, and zero pressure.

Document every consult, log every objection, follow up every "let me think about it" within 48 hours.

Operate within Maryland Rule of Professional Conduct compliance: no legal advice, no outcome guarantees, clean handoff to attorneys.



COMPENSATION



Base plus Performance and Quarterly Conversion Bonus



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS



3+ years in a closing sales role with documented quota attainment. You will be running consults solo from Day 30. We need someone who has already closed deals on their own and can talk through the numbers. If you have carried a real book of business and hit quota, you already know how this ramp feels. If you have only assisted, qualified, or scheduled, this seat will overwhelm you in the first month.



Closed deals at average sizes of $3,000 or higher. Our service tiers run from $3,500 to $25,000 per matter. Selling at this price point is a different muscle than selling subscriptions or low-ticket products. If you have closed in this range or higher, you already know how to handle the price conversation, the hesitation, and the 
nt a spouse pushes back on the call. That experience matters more than the industry.



Consultative selling experience, multi-touch deal cycles. Our prospects are not impulse buyers. Most d
 after one or two conversations, and discovery-driven selling is the work. If you have run advisory, solution, or needs-based sales, you will recognize the pattern. If your training is mostly script-and-pitch, you will struggle to hit the conversion target.



Demonstrated emotional intelligence in high-stakes conversations. Every consult is someone going through one of the hardest decisions of their life. They are afraid, sometimes angry, sometimes grieving. You will be the first professional voice they hear, and they will d
 whether they trust us in the first ten minutes. If you have sold in medical, financial planning, end-of-life services, or any setting where the buyer is in distress, you already have the muscle this role demands.



Reliable home office and strong English fluency. We are fully remote. You will be on video calls daily with clients and with the firm, so a quiet, professional home office and reliable internet are non-negotiable. Strong written and spoken English is required, including drafting follow-up
s and capturing case notes that go directly to the attorneys.



PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)



These will move your application to the top of the stack but are not deal-breakers.



Legal services sales experience, any practice area. Faster ramp on terminology and process.

Familiarity with the "How To Manage A Small Law Firm" model or "dragon" intake methodology. If you have sold inside a small-law-firm sales structure, you will recognize ours.

Premium retail leadership at Pandora, Tiffany, Nordstrom, or a comparable tier. Your training in client experience and brand discipline transfers directly.

Bilingual English and Spanish. A meaningful portion of our client base prefers Spanish for sensitive conversations.

Maryland-based. No premium for it, but convenient for occasional in-person team time.

Prior experience with Clio, Lawmatics, Salesforce, or HubSpot. Less time on tool training in your first 30 days.

Direct experience selling against insurance, retainers, or installment-payment products. Our payment structures will feel familiar.





WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



Pure intake or scheduling backgrounds. We have an Intake Specialist already.

Attorneys looking for a non-attorney role. We hire closers, not future lateral attorneys.

Anyone currently working at a "How To Manage A Small Law Firm" model firm. Conflict.

Cold-outbound SaaS BDRs with no human-services experience. The work is different.

Anyone who sells with pressure, urgency tactics, or discount-as-default.



Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your sales experience in a professional organization.

As part of the interview process, please also complete an initial interview using the Initial AI Interview Link:

We are a UK-based Amazon FBA business looking for a reliable Product Research Virtual Assistant to help identify profitable products for Online Arbitrage and Wholesale sourcing.



This role focuses on QUALITY OVER QUANTITY. The objective is not to analyse the highest number of products, but to identify stable, profitable opportunities that meet clear and realistic buying criteria.

....................................................................



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



Scan supplier and wholesale product lists

Research products on Amazon UK

Analyse Keepa charts and price history

Calculate profit, ROI and competition levels

Identify stable and realistic buying opportunities

Record results accurately in Google Sheets

....................................................................



REQUIREMENTS



Experience with Amazon FBA product research (Online Arbitrage or Wholesale)

Understanding of Keepa charts and Amazon fees

Strong attention to detail

Ability to prioritise accuracy over speed

Good English communication

Reliable internet connection



....................................................................



WORK STRUCTURE



Initial paid trial period (1 full day, 8 hours). In some cases a few trial days may be used to ensure a good long-term fit.

Trial rate: $2.00 per hour.

No bonus during the trial period.



After successful trial, the role moves to part-time and eventually full-time work.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber. Pay for this role WILL increase over time as performance, reliability and results improve.



....................................................................



PAY STRUCTURE



Base pay is $3.00 per hour.



In addition, performance bonuses are paid for product leads that meet our buying criteria and are approved for purchase. The bonus structure rewards accuracy and quality rather than high volume.



Bonus structure example:



Approved product with approximately £100–£199 total expected profit ? $3 bonus

Approved product with approximately £200–£399 total expected profit ? $5 bonus

Approved product with approximately £400+ total expected profit ? $15 bonus



This structure encourages focusing on stronger opportunities rather than sending large numbers of low-quality leads.



This will include any wholesale excel sheets I provide (I will be sending quite a few of these to be scanned)



We prefer fewer high-quality leads instead of many low-quality submissions.



....................................................................



EXAMPLE BUYING CRITERIA (FOR GUIDANCE ONLY)

Minimum ROI around 30%

Minimum profit around £3 per unit

Stable pricing history on Keepa

Reasonable competition levels

Products with strong overall profit potential

....................................................................

6) What criteria do you believe is most important when d
 if a product is a good buy?

7) Describe a situation where you d
 NOT to buy a product and why.



We value honest and realistic answers more than impressive numbers.



??????????????????

title: URGENT! Multimedia Artist (Graphic Design + Video Editing + Web/UI-UX) Project-Based ? Possible Full-Time
description:
Hey, you.

Yeah, you — the one who can make a brand look like a million bucks, cut a video that actually gives people chills, and probably has opinions about kerning and loading speeds that most people in your life don't want to hear about. We see you. We need you.

We're Redfern Media, a digital marketing agency out of Dallas, Texas that's been in this game for nearly two decades. We've worked with some names you'd recognize — folks from Shark Tank, Dr. Benjamin Hardy (bestselling author of Personality Isn't Permanent and Who Not How), Robin Sharma (yes, the guy who wrote The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari), and a growing roster of founders, visionaries, and companies doing genuinely cool things. We move fast, we care about craft, and we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously.

Right now, we're bringing on a Multimedia Artist for a project-based engagement — and if you're as good as we think you are, this has the very real potential to turn into something full-time.



Why We're Hiring Right Now

We've just onboarded a really exciting new client — a health-tech marketplace company preparing for a major investor pitch event in late April. Think: pitch decks, a two-minute brand video, one-pagers, booth materials. It's a tight timeline, the stakes are real, and we need someone who can hit the ground running without needing their hand held. After the initial sprint, there's a full website overhaul, ongoing brand creative, and more work lined up — so this isn't a one-and-done.

> Refine and produce a 2-minute brand/pitch video (scripted, edited, polished — the kind that makes people stop scrolling)

> Refresh booth display materials for a live event

> Create a clean, compelling investor one-pager

> Polish up an investor pitch deck — visually, not just content-wise





What Comes After (The Bigger Picture)

Once we clear April, here's what the ongoing work looks like:



> Full website redesign — homepage overhaul, core pages, audience-specific landing pages (this is where your UI/UX chops come in)

> Ongoing brand creative — ads, social assets,
 visuals, collateral

> Sales and partner materials — guidebooks, onboarding decks, partner-facing one-pagers

> Video content as the brand scales — explainer videos, campaign content, event assets

> Whatever else comes up, because it always does





What We're Looking For

> 5–8+ years of hands-on experience as a multimedia artist, creative generalist, or similar

> Rock-solid graphic design skills — you know your way around Adobe Creative Suite, Canva Pro, whatever the job needs

> Strong video editing chops — you can take raw footage or a script and turn it into something people actually want to watch

> Web design and UI/UX experience — you don't just make things look good, you think about how people move through them

> You work well under a deadline without the drama

description:

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Caerify is a US-based market intelligence holding company building four data-driven SaaS platforms across real estate, business intelligence, and consumer fraud verification. We operate a single shared codebase across all platforms. You will be the primary developer working directly with

 verification utility

 feasibility report generator

The architecture is defined. The stack is locked. Your job is to build to spec, flag problems early, and maintain clean code across a shared monorepo.

WHAT YOU WILL DO DAY TO DAY:

 billing flows

- Expand database schema and data pipelines

- Build form flows, admin queues, and 

 user-facing dashboards

 Google Places, Anthropic)

- Write clean, typed TypeScript throughout

- Maintain and extend shared component library

- Participate in weekly video check-ins with 

 the founder

- Document your work clearly in the codebase



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO:

- Make architectural decisions unilaterally

- Introduce new tools or libraries without 

 founder approval

- Work on multiple platforms simultaneously 

 without clear prioritization from founder

- Skip code documentation



YOU ARE THE RIGHT FIT IF:

- You have 2+ years of real full-stack experience

- You have shipped a Next.js + Supabase project that is publicly accessible or on GitHub

- You communicate problems early, not after they've cost days of work

- You can work independently from a spec 

 without needing daily hand-holding

- You are comfortable on video calls in English

- You are available during overlapping hours 

 with US Eastern Time (at minimum 4 hours 

 of overlap per day)



YOU ARE NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF:

- You have only worked on tutorial projects 

 or spec work without real users

- You cannot explain your architectural 

 decisions in plain English

- You disappear when problems get hard

- Your GitHub shows no recent activity



?? APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS — READ CAREFULLY

Applications that do not follow these instructions 

exactly will not be reviewed. No exceptions.



TO APPLY YOU MUST INCLUDE ALL FOUR OF THESE:



1. GITHUB LINK

  Your GitHub profile URL. Must show recent 

  commits (within last 60 days). Inactive

2. PROJECT LINK

"Describe how you would implement a Stripe subscription with a 7-day free trial in a Next.js App Router project using Supabase to store subscription status. What webhook events would you listen for and why?"  A correct, specific answer is required. Vague answers will be rejected.



4. AVAILABILITY STATEMENT

Confirm your daily availability in Philippine time and how many hours overlap with US Eastern Time you can provide.

DO NOT apply if you cannot provide a real

Full-time

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?



Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™



We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.



At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.



Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.



What You Will Be Responsible For:

• Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages

• Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences

• Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience

• Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance

• Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion

• Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd

• Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage

• Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams



What We Are Looking For:

• 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.

• A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed.

• Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.

• Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.

• Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.

• Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.

• Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus



Success Roadmap:



In 30 Days, You'll:

• Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.

• Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.

• Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.

• Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.



In 60 Days, You'll:

• Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.

• Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.

• Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.

• Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process



In 90 Days, You'll:

• Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design

• Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.

• Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.

• Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.

 

By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

• Faster landing page creation and iteration

• Higher-quality post-click experiences

• Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure

• A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click



Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

title: QA Manager
description:
WE’RE HIRING! JOIN OUR TEAM!



Position: QA Manager

Company: Baton (
)

Location: 100% Remote (WFH)

Work Hours: Mountain Standard Time

Rate/Salary: $8-10 per hour



About the Role



Baton is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented QA Manager to oversee quality assurance, compliance, buyer performance, and traffic quality across our call marketplace.



This role is responsible for monitoring call quality, publisher compliance, buyer performance, refund trends, and operational risks to ensure the marketplace maintains high standards of quality and accountability. The QA Manager will proactively identify issues, investigate root causes, and work cross-functionally with Publisher Management, Client Success, Operations, Sales, and Leadership to improve conversion outcomes, reduce preventable credits, and strengthen partner performance.



This is a highly visible role that combines quality assurance, compliance oversight, reporting, operational analysis, and process improvement.



Key Responsibilities



Credit & Refund Oversight

- Monitor credit and refund trends by buyer, campaign, publisher, sub-ID, and category.

- Identify recurring fail reasons, unusual approval rates, and emerging patterns.

- Investigate whether issues originate from traffic quality or buyer-side operational failures.

- Flag buyers with excessive refund requests or abnormal credit behavior.

- Develop recurring reports highlighting refund drivers and trends.

- Recommend corrective actions including routing adjustments, bid changes, publisher feedback, buyer coaching, and traffic filtering improvements.



Call Quality Assurance

- Review call recordings, transcripts, and call outcomes on a daily and weekly basis.

- Evaluate transfer quality, buyer call handling, and overall caller experience.

- Review AI-assisted call interactions where applicable.

- Identify fraud, coached callers, low-intent leads, wrong-service inquiries, compliance concerns, and other quality issues.

- Maintain a library of common quality issues, examples, and training materials.



Buyer Performance Monitoring

- Track buyer answer rates, connection rates, call handling effectiveness, and responsiveness.

- Identify buyers missing calls, creating poor caller experiences, or generating avoidable credits.

- Analyze operational issues impacting conversion performance.

- Surface trends by buyer, region, and campaign.

- Escalate performance concerns to Sales, Client Success, Operations, and Leadership teams.

- Support initiatives that improve buyer accountability and service levels.



Compliance Management

- Maintain publisher compliance records and documentation.

- Ensure required certifications, disclosures, traffic source information, and supporting materials are current and complete.

- Monitor renewal and recertification requirements.

- Review landing pages, disclaimers, and traffic source declarations for compliance.

- Investigate TCPA-related concerns and other compliance alerts.

- Escalate high-risk publishers or traffic sources when necessary.

- Maintain audit-ready compliance documentation.



Alert Monitoring & Investigation

- Monitor alerts related to fraud, TCPA risk, answer-rate issues, abnormal call behavior, and - refund spikes.

- Conduct root cause investigations and document findings.

- Recommend and track corrective actions.

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve recurring issues.



Reporting & Trend Analysis

- Develop and maintain QA scorecards and performance dashboards.

- Create recurring reports for leadership on:

- Traffic quality

- Buyer performance

- Refund trends

- Compliance risk

- Operational performance

- Translate data into actionable recommendations.

- Measure the effectiveness of implemented solutions over time.



SOP Ownership & Process Improvement

- Create, document, and maintain standard operating procedures for:

- Call reviews

- Compliance reviews

- Refund investigations

- Escalation management

- Quality assurance processes

- Standardize QA definitions, audit criteria, and review methodologies.

- Improve workflows between QA, Publisher Management, Sales, Client Success, and Operations.

- Assist with training and coaching around recurring quality and compliance issues.



Escalation Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for quality and compliance escalations.

- Route issues to the appropriate teams and stakeholders.

- Track investigations through resolution.

- Identify systemic issues and implement long-term solutions.



Additional Responsibilities

- Audit call disposition accuracy and consistency.

- Review category mapping and call routing logic.

- Monitor buyer coverage failures and no-answer trends.

- Support dispute resolution through call reviews and documentation.

- Maintain training examples of approved versus non-approved traffic.

- Partner with Data and Engineering teams to improve dashboards, alerts, and reporting.

- Help establish thresholds for buyer warnings, pauses, and escalations.



Qualifications



Required

- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, Operations, Call Center Management, - Lead Generation, Performance Marketing, or a related field.

- Strong analytical and investigative skills.

- Experience reviewing call recordings, transcripts, and performance data.

- Ability to identify trends and root causes across large datasets.

- Strong reporting and dashboard experience.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

- Experience creating SOPs, documentation, and process improvements.



Preferred

- Experience in pay-per-call, lead generation, affiliate marketing, or call marketplaces.

- Familiarity with TCPA compliance and call tracking platforms.

- Experience working with publisher networks, buyers, and performance marketing ecosystems.

- Experience with AI-driven call handling or conversational AI platforms.

- Experience using CRM, BI, and reporting tools.



Success Metrics (KPIs)

- Accurate and timely delivery of credit and refund trend reporting.

- Percentage of active publishers reviewed monthly.

- Percentage of high-risk buyers audited monthly.

- Time to investigate and escalate quality concerns.

- Reduction in preventable credits and refunds.

- Reduction in buyer-side answer rate and connectivity issues.

- Reduction in invalid, misrouted, or wrong-category calls.

- Compliance documentation completion and audit readiness.

- Alert investigation and resolution rates.

- QA audit volume, quality, and turnaround time.



What Success Looks Like



The successful QA Manager will create visibility into marketplace quality, identify risks before they become costly problems, improve buyer and publisher accountability, strengthen compliance standards, and help Baton maximize revenue by reducing preventable credits and operational inefficiencies.

title: Outbound BDR / Appointment Setter
description:
EMPLOYMENT: Full-time, 40 hours/week, North American hours (9:00am to 5:00pm EST)



Launch & Found is hiring a dedicated Business Development Representative to own the top of our sales funnel: sourcing prospects, getting them on the phone, and booking qualified appointments for our closer. This is a senior, phone-first role for an experienced outbound professional who runs independently and holds themselves to a high standard.



About Us

Launch & Found is a SaaS and growth marketing agency for local service businesses. We specialize in scaling brands with paid advertising. We also give clients one system that gets them found and gets them booked: a conversion-focused website, missed-call text-back, automated lead follow-up, review generation, and local SEO, all on one flat monthly rate. Clients ready to scale add professional video and an AI receptionist. Our market is local business owners across Canada and the US.



We are a small, fast-moving team that takes pride in excellent work and treats its people well.



The Role

You will own the entire top of our sales funnel, from first list to booked meeting.

- You source your own prospects. We do not hand you lists. You build them, with the owner's name and direct line: local service businesses (contractors, trades, home services, and similar owner-operated companies) across Canada and the US.

- You reach the right person. You build rapport with whoever answers, turn the gatekeeper into an ally, and get to the decision-maker.

- You sell the meeting. You will not close the deal yourself, our closer does that, but you are selling on every call: opening with confidence, creating genuine interest, handling objections, and booking the appointment.

- You sustain your 
ntum. You bring the same energy to your ninetieth call of the day as your first.



What You Will Own

- A pipeline you have sourced yourself

- 75 to 150+ quality dials per day

- 8+ qualified appointments booked each week

- An accurate, up-to-date CRM your closer can rely on



What You Bring

- Several years of outbound phone sales, appointment setting, or SDR experience

- A proven ability to build B2B lead lists from scratch with tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or Google Maps

- Confidence and warmth on the phone, with a calm, skilled way of handling objections and gatekeepers

- The instinct to sell an outcome to a busy, skeptical owner-operator, not just pitch features

- Clear, easy-to-understand English (our buyers are in Canada and the US)

- The discipline to run your own desk with minimal supervision



What We Offer

- Growth: as our first BDR, you will build the playbook and grow as we do

- A clean offer: one flat rate that pays for itself, so you sell the meeting instead of fighting the price

- Direct access: you work closely with our founders and our closer, not buried under layers of management

- Purpose: you will represent an agency that helps small businesses win

- Real upside: a competitive base plus an uncapped bonus on every appointment that shows

- Balance: clear hours, a supportive remote team, and no weekend work



How to Apply

We review every application personally. Please send:

1. A 60 to 90 second voice recording so we can hear your phone presence.

2. Three sentences on why this role is right for you and what you would bring.



Applicants who complete both steps will be reviewed first. We look forward to hearing from you.



Andy

Co-Founder & CEO

Launch and Found

title: Microsoft 365 Solutions Specialist (SharePoint, Teams & Governance)
description:
*KINDLY READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION & THE APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.*



About the Organization 



EJF Real Estate Services and The Nabo Group are growing organizations focused on real estate investment and property/HOA management across multiple regions. Our operations rely heavily on structured document management, secure collaboration, and scalable systems to support property portfolios, boards, and internal teams. 



We are undergoing a transformation to modernize and standardize our Microsoft 365 environment, with a strong focus on SharePoint Online, governance, and operational efficiency. 



Overview 



We are seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Solutions Specialist (SharePoint, Teams & Governance) to design and implement a scalable, secure, and governance-driven collaboration environment tailored to a multi-entity real estate and property management organization within the Corporate IT Department. 



This role will focus on building a structured and standardized environment across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and Microsoft Entra ID, enabling efficient document management, controlled access, and future-ready AI and automation capabilities. 



The ideal candidate is a strategic architect, not just an administrator, with experience designing environments that support distributed teams, regional operations, and complex permission models.



Duties & Responsibilities:



Architecture & Design:

 

•  Design enterprise-grade SharePoint Online architecture aligned to:  

 -  Properties / communities (HOAs)  

 -  Regions / portfolios  

 -  Internal departments (Finance, Operations, Legal, etc.)  

•  Implement a hub-and-spoke model with clear hierarchy and navigation  

•  Define scalable information architecture:  

 -  Metadata vs folder structures  

 -  Content types and taxonomy  

 -  Standardized document libraries  

•  Establish site provisioning models and templates for repeatable property onboarding  

•  Align SharePoint with Microsoft Teams and OneDrive usage patterns  



Governance & Compliance:

 

•  Develop and document a SharePoint governance framework tailored to property management operations:  

 -  Naming conventions (properties, regions, departments)  

 -  Site lifecycle management (onboarding/offboarding properties)  

 -  Permission models (board members, internal staff, vendors)  

•  Implement data governance and compliance controls:  

 -  Retention policies for property records and financial documents  

 -  Sensitivity labels and secure document handling  

 -  External sharing controls for board members and third parties  

•  Ensure alignment with real estate and property management operational needs  



Microsoft 365 Integration:  



•  Architect seamless integration across:  

 -  SharePoint Online  

 -  Microsoft Teams (for property and internal collaboration)  

 -  OneDrive (personal vs organizational data boundaries)  

 -  Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) 

•  Design scalable identity and access strategies:  

 -  Role-based access (internal staff, board members, vendors)  

 -  Group-based provisioning  

 -  Conditional access awareness  



Automation & AI Readiness:

 

•  Structure SharePoint for Microsoft Copilot readiness (clean, well-organized data)  

•  Identify opportunities for:  

 -  Power Automate workflows (approvals, document routing, onboarding)  

 -  Process automation for property management operations  

•  Improve search, discoverability, and document intelligence  



Migration & Optimization:



•  Assess current SharePoint and file storage environments  

•  Identify gaps, duplication, and inefficiencies  

•  Develop a migration and consolidation strategy  

•  Optimize usability for both:  

 -  Internal teams  

 -  Non-technical users (property managers, board members)  



Documentation & Knowledge Transfer:

 

•  Deliver:  

 -  Architecture diagrams  

 -  Governance framework documentation  

 -  Implementation and rollout roadmap  

•  Provide knowledge transfer to internal IT leadership and support teams  





Required Qualifications:

 

•  5+ years of experience with SharePoint Online (modern experience required)  

•  5+ years across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem  

•  Proven experience designing enterprise or multi-entity SharePoint architectures  

•  Strong understanding of:  

 -  Microsoft Teams & SharePoint integration  

 -  Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)  

 -  Complex permission and access control models  

•  Experience with:  

 -  Metadata and taxonomy design  

 -  Governance frameworks  

 -  Scalable site provisioning strategies  





Preferred Qualifications:

 

•  Experience supporting property management, real estate, or HOA environments  

•  Experience with multi-entity or portfolio-based organizations  

•  Familiarity with:  

 -  Microsoft Purview (retention, compliance, labeling)  

 -  Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps)  

 -  Microsoft Copilot readiness and data structuring  

• Microsoft certifications (nice to have):  

 -  MS-100 / MS-101  

 -  MS-700  

 -  SharePoint / M365 certifications 



Working Hours: 9:00 am – 5:00 pm EST; Monday – Friday (US time zones)



Benefits: HMO and PTO after 90 days.

title: Group Cruise Lead Generation Virtual Assistant
description:

Industry: Travel / Cruises / Group Sales

We are seeking a motivated, confident Virtual Assistant to research and cold-call organizations to identify large group cruise opportunities (25+ cabins).

Your job is NOT to sell — your job is to find, qualify, and pass warm group leads to our Group Cruise Consultant for closing.

* Is comfortable cold calling U.S. businesses

* Can handle rejection professionally

* Knows how to ask qualifying questions

* Wants long-term, stable work with bonuses

Research U.S.-based organizations and group planners

Cold call decision-makers (churches, schools, clubs, companies, etc.)

Qualify group size (25+ cabins or growth potential)

Confirm travel interest and timeframe

Collect accurate contact information

Log all activity in Google Sheets / CRM

Pass ONLY qualified leads to the consultant



QUALIFICATIONS (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY)

REQUIRED:

Proven cold calling or appointment setting experience

Clear, neutral English (easy to understand)

Comfortable calling U.S. phone numbers

Strong listening and communication skills

Organized and reliable

Able to work independently



PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED):

Sales or lead generation background

Travel or cruise industry experience

Salesforce or CRM experience



DAILY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

100+ outbound calls per day

30–50 new leads researched daily

5–10 qualified group leads per week

Accurate and complete call notes



PAY & INCENTIVES

Base Pay: $4–$7 per hour (based on experience)

Performance Bonuses Available

Bonus per qualified group lead

Additional bonuses for booked groups

Opportunity for long-term work and pay increases



 SCHEDULE

Flexible hours

Must be available to call U.S. business hours

Part-time to start, with potential to grow



 SAMPLE CALL SCRIPT (FOR REFERENCE)

“Hi, my name is ___, I’m calling on behalf of a group cruise specialist.

We work with organizations planning large group trips of 25 cabins or more.

I wanted to see if your group has any upcoming travel plans in the next 6–18 months.”

(No selling. Qualification only.)

Please include:

A brief summary of your cold-calling experience

The number of calls you can make per day

Your English proficiency level

Your internet speed and headset availability

Start your application with the word: CRUISE

(Applications that do not follow instructions will not be considered.)

Long-term opportunity

Clear expectations

Bonuses for performance

No selling pressure

Supportive, professional environment

• Identify areas for process improvement and lead implementation

• Provide support for audits and tax matters

• Participate in setting standards and improving workflows

• Develop documentation and strengthen internal controls



What We’re Looking For

• Strong analytical skills and thorough knowledge of accounting principles

• Excellent organizational and leadership abilities

• Experience in managing accounting workflows and team supervision

• Ability to adapt, take initiative, and lead process improvements

• Familiarity with project management and accounting software tools

• Must have U.S. accounting experience

title: AI Systems Architect/Automation & Marketplace Specialist
description:
Job Title: AI Systems Architect/Automation & Marketplace Specialist

Location: Remote

Job Type: Part-Time | Long-Term

Starting Rate: $5.00/hour (Increase after 90-day performance & revenue review)



We are seeking a highly skilled, systems-minded professional with deep understanding of AI, marketplaces, automations, APIs, GoHighLevel (GHL), and e-commerce ecosystems. This role is critical in building and supporting the infrastructure behind our mall and related business systems. We are looking for someone serious, long-term focused, and capable of creating and managing full operational systems from the ground up.



Overview

We are looking for an AI Systems Architect & Automation Specialist who can design, build, and maintain complete digital infrastructures across multiple business units. This includes AI-driven workflows, marketplace systems, automation pipelines, API integrations, and e-commerce operations.

This role is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, understands how digital ecosystems connect, and can turn business needs into scalable technical solutions.



Job Details

In this role, you will be responsible for building and optimizing the core infrastructure that powers our mall ecosystem and related businesses. You will work across AI tools, automation systems, CRM platforms like GoHighLevel, and various e-commerce and marketplace environments.

Your work will directly impact operational efficiency, revenue generation, and the scalability of our entire business network.



What You’ll Be Doing

AI Systems & Infrastructure

Design and implement AI-powered workflows and automation systems

Build scalable infrastructure for business operations and marketplaces

Integrate AI tools into daily operational processes

Develop systems that improve efficiency and reduce manual work

Automation & API Integration

Create and manage automation workflows across platforms

Integrate third-party APIs into internal systems

Connect tools such as CRMs, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms

Ensure seamless data flow between systems

GoHighLevel (GHL) & CRM Systems

Build and optimize funnels, pipelines, and automation workflows in GHL

Manage CRM structures and lead tracking systems

Automate client journeys and business processes

E-Commerce & Marketplace Systems

Support and develop e-commerce store infrastructure

Assist in building and scaling online marketplace systems

Ensure smooth operational flow across multiple business units

Systems Architecture & Problem Solving

Design full end-to-end business systems

Identify inefficiencies and build automation solutions

Translate business needs into technical execution

Continuously improve infrastructure and scalability

Data, Operations & Execution

Ensure systems are reliable, structured, and well-documented

Maintain organized workflows and process documentation

Support revenue-generating initiatives through automation



What You Bring to the Role

Strong understanding of AI tools and system integration

Experience with automation platforms and API integrations

Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

Knowledge of e-commerce ecosystems and marketplaces

Ability to design and build full system infrastructures

Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking ability

Ability to work independently and execute quickly



Preferred Qualifications

Experience building end-to-end automation systems for businesses

Background in AI implementation or systems architecture

Experience working with multiple SaaS tools and integrations

Prior work with scalable online business ecosystems or marketplaces



What You Can Expect

Starting rate of $5.00/hour

Performance and revenue-based review after 90 days

Opportunity for increase to $7.00/hour based on results

Long-term position with growth potential

Opportunity to participate in mall ecosystem businesses and affiliate programs

Ability to build and own systems that directly impact revenue

Collaborative long-term role in a growing business infrastructure



About the Company

We are building a multi-business digital ecosystem and marketplace infrastructure focused on scalable operations, automation, and revenue generation. Our goal is to create a highly efficient, AI-powered business environment that connects multiple ventures under one system.

We value long-term partners who are execution-focused, systems-driven, and capable of building real infrastructure that drives measurable results.

title: Lead Operations & CRM Maintenance Specialist
description:
Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Lead Operations & Data Analyst to oversee lead tracking, data hygiene, and reporting across our marketing, call center, and operations teams.

This role is responsible for ensuring accurate lead attribution, maintaining data integrity within our systems, identifying discrepancies, monitoring lead quality, and providing reporting that helps drive business decisions. The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-motivated, and enjoys investigating data to identify trends, errors, and opportunities for improvement.



Key Responsibilities

Lead & Job Data Management

Review newly created leads and jobs to ensure accurate source tracking and attribution.

Verify continuity between lead providers, call center bookings, and completed jobs.

Audit data regularly to identify and correct errors, duplicates, and missing information.

Ensure data consistency across multiple platforms and systems.



Lead Vendor Management

Monitor lead quality from various lead aggregator platforms.

Identify invalid, duplicate, or otherwise refundable leads.

Submit refund requests and disputes to lead providers when appropriate.

Track vendor performance and maintain records of lead quality trends.



Reporting & Analytics

Create, maintain, and improve reporting dashboards in Google Sheets.

Consolidate data from multiple systems and sources into actionable reports.

Track key performance indicators including:

Cost per Lead (CPL)

Lead Conversion Rates

Return on Investment (ROI)

Booking Rates

Revenue by Lead Source

Lead Quality Metrics

Identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.

Process Improvement

Develop and maintain data management procedures.

Recommend improvements to lead tracking and reporting processes.

Work closely with call center and management teams to improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.



Requirements

Required Skills

Advanced Google Sheets experience, including:

Formulas

Pivot Tables

Data Validation

Reporting Dashboards

Data Analysis

Strong attention to detail.

Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Comfortable reviewing large amounts of data and identifying inconsistencies.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with lead generation companies and lead aggregators.

Experience in call center operations, scheduling, dispatching, or service industries.

Familiarity with CRM and job management systems.

Experience tracking marketing performance and lead attribution.

Understanding of ROI, conversion metrics, and operational reporting.



Success in This Role

The successful candidate will be someone who naturally questions inconsistencies, enjoys solving data problems, and takes ownership of maintaining accurate reporting and lead tracking. Their work will directly impact marketing decisions, lead quality management, and overall business performance.





Please include on your proposal your answer to this question, failure to include will remove you from the application. 

1. Tell me about your experience working with lead tracking, lead attribution, or marketing data.

2. Have you worked with lead aggregators or lead generation vendors before? Which platforms?

3. Describe a time when you discovered an error in reporting or data. How did you identify and resolve it?

title: LinkedIn and Email Lead Generation Specialist / Appointment Setter ($1,300/ month)
description:
LinkedIn and
 Lead Generation Specialist / Appointment Setter

Full Time | Remote | $1,300 USD per month



Who We Are

Lucky Growth Partners is a performance marketing agency that helps serious clients grow through smart, targeted lead generation. We move fast, we value ownership, and we hold ourselves to a high standard. As we scale, we need someone sharp and self directed to help us connect with the right people at the right time and fill our calendar with qualified conversations.

You will report directly to the Operations Manager and the Founders. No layers, no bureaucracy. Just clear expectations and real opportunity.



What This Role Is About

This is a pure outbound role. Your job is to identify the right prospects, start real conversations, and book qualified discovery calls for the team. We give you the target industries and ideal client profiles. You own everything from there: building the lists, writing the outreach, following up consistently, and keeping the pipeline moving.

If you need someone to tell you who to contact every morning or walk you through each step, this is not the role for you. If you thrive working independently, take ownership of your results, and know how to write a message that actually gets a reply — keep reading.



Core Responsibilities



Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Search, and other research tools

Send daily LinkedIn connection requests and personalised follow up messages to qualified prospects

Write and send cold
s to high value leads that feel human and relevant, not templated

Maintain a clean and organised prospect pipeline inside the CRM at all times

Follow up consistently across all active leads until there is a clear outcome

Book discovery calls and coordinate scheduling directly with the Founders

Log all outreach activity accurately in ClickUp and the CRM every day

Communicate updates, blockers, and wins clearly through Slack on a daily basis





What We Are Looking For



Proven experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify and reach high value B2B leads

Strong written English with the ability to craft outreach that feels personal and earns replies

Solid experience with cold
 outreach including writing, sequencing, and follow up

Comfortable managing and tracking a full pipeline inside a CRM

Highly organised with the ability to handle a large number of active prospects at once

Takes initiative, works independently, and does not need to be chased for updates

Available full time during UK business hours (BST)





Bonus Points If You Have



Background in B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or performance marketing

Experience booking calls for a high ticket offer or agency service

Hands on familiarity with outreach tools like Apollo, Instantly, or Smartlead





Logic Question — Required

Your target: digital marketing agencies with 10 to 50 employees that are actively running paid ads for clients. You have LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Search, and Google Workspace. No existing data. Your goal is to book 5 discovery calls within 7 days.

Walk us through exactly what you would do from day one. How do you build the list, who do you target, what does your outreach look like, and how do you follow up? Be specific.

We are not grading for a perfect answer. We want to see how you think, how you plan, and whether you can move without being directed every step of the way.



Video Introduction — Required

Record a 2 to 3 minute video and upload it to Loom or Google Drive. Include the link in your application. Cover who you are, your experience in outbound sales or appointment setting, one specific result you are proud of with real numbers behind it, and why this role is the right fit for you right now.



Before You Apply — Read This

To confirm you have read this post carefully and have the attention to detail this role demands, begin your cover letter with the exact phrase: "I want to be lucky."

Applications that do not open with this phrase will not be reviewed, regardless of experience or qualifications.



Do Not Apply If...



You need daily task lists and cannot manage your own outreach pipeline

You copy and paste the same generic application for every role you go for

You have no real hands on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or cold

You are not comfortable being directly accountable to Founders and an Operations Manager

You cannot commit to working full time during UK business hours (BST)





What We Offer



$1,300 USD per month, full time, reviewed after probation

Full time remote position with a stable and growing agency

Direct access to Founders and the Operations Manager with no layers in between

Long term opportunity to grow as the business scales

A team that values output, respects ownership, and moves quickly





How to Apply

Submit your CV and cover letter (starting with the required phrase), your logic question response, and your Loom or Google Drive video link. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

title: Engineering Support Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking a tech-savvy and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our engineering MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) team. This role increases engineering capacity by handling technical tool support, workflow automation, data management, and documentation, keeping our processes accurate, efficient, and ready for engineering review.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Engineering Workflow & Project Support

- Assist with internal project coordination, including status updates, follow-ups, and task tracking across active MEP jobs.

- Maintain internal project trackers, ensuring all tasks, submittals, and job files are current and properly labeled.

- Organize job files, inputs, calculations, and supporting documentation to ensure smooth engineering execution.

- Update and maintain project data across relevant platforms to keep records accurate and current.



2. Excel / Blockpad / Mathcad Transition Support

- Review and interpret existing Excel calculators and workbooks; map logic and structure into new engineering tools as directed.

- Recreate formulas, variable logic, and calculation flows in the target platform (e.g., Blockpad) under direct engineering guidance.

- Validate outputs against expected results and flag any discrepancies for engineering review.

- Provide occasional support for Blockpad-specific tasks as assigned.



3. Technical Operations & Automation Support

- Assist with workflow automation initiatives using Microsoft Power Automate and PowerShell.

- Support the development of reusable templates, standardized calculation sets, and structured file-routing logic.

- Identify and implement opportunities to reduce manual, repetitive steps across engineering workflows.



4. Communication & Documentation

- Provide clear, timely written updates on task progress, blockers, and next steps.

- Document internal processes and create simple guides or checklists for repeatable engineering tasks.

- Maintain accurate document control for design submittals, project logs, and client markups.



REQUIRED SKILLS & TOOLS

- Microsoft Excel — Advanced proficiency (formulas, structured workbooks, data validation)

- Power Automate / PowerShell — Working knowledge of workflow automation

- Blockpad — Basic familiarity or willingness to learn on the job

- PDF markup & document control — Experience with submittal logs and project documentation

- Technical Writing — Ability to document processes clearly and concisely

- Communication — Excellent written English; responsive and proactive



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Background in engineering support, technical administration, or a related field

- Familiarity with MEP terminology, drawing organization, and design documentation

- Experience working with engineering platforms or calculation tools

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a remote environment



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE MEANS

- You help the team stay focused on design and problem-solving — by keeping every project file organized, every automation workflow running, and every Excel/Blockpad calculation accurate and ready for engineering review.

 and data migrations

title: Claude Code Expert - Vibe Coder
description:
Location: Fully Remote (PH)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST (with flexibility as needed for client impact events)

About T3 Tech Partners

T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Microsoft 365, cloud, security, and AI engineering expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.

We build and operate AI-powered applications that automate the most time-consuming parts of MSP work — tenant management, reporting, security reviews, and migrations. Our stack runs on DigitalOcean and is powered by the Anthropic API.



Role Overview

We are seeking a senior AI Application Engineer to design, build, and operate production applications powered by the Anthropic API. You'll own the backend services, integrations, and infrastructure that turn Claude into reliable, multi-tenant tooling for MSPs and their clients.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll write the code, ship the features, deploy the services, watch the dashboards, and tune the prompts. You should be equally comfortable architecting a tool-use loop against the Messages API, debugging a Node service on a DigitalOcean droplet, designing a Postgres schema for multi-tenant isolation, and explaining cost trade-offs to leadership.



Key Responsibilities

Anthropic API & AI Application Development (Core Focus)



Design and build production applications on top of the Anthropic API — Messages, tool use, streaming, prompt caching, batch processing, the Files API, and MCP connectors where appropriate.

Architect multi-turn agentic workflows, tool-use loops, and structured-output pipelines that hold up against real customer data, not just demos.

Implement robust prompt and context engineering practices: system prompt design, dynamic context assembly, retrieval, and output validation.

Build evals and regression suites so prompt and model changes don't silently degrade behavior in production.

Optimize for cost and latency at scale: prompt caching strategies, model selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), batch processing for non-realtime workloads, and token budgets per tenant.

Implement guardrails: input validation, output verification, rate limiting, abuse detection, and safe handling of customer data.



Backend & API Engineering



Build and maintain backend services in Python and/or Node.js/TypeScript, exposing clean REST or RPC APIs to internal tools, partner integrations, and end-user products.

Design multi-tenant data models in PostgreSQL with proper tenant isolation, encryption, and audit logging.

Integrate with the Microsoft Graph, Google Workspace Admin SDK, and MSP platform APIs (SuperOps, Hudu, and similar) to feed Claude with the right context and act on its outputs.

Implement authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, app registrations, service principals) across Microsoft and Google identity ecosystems.

Design background job systems, queues, and webhook handlers for long-running AI workflows.



DigitalOcean Infrastructure & Operations



Own the deployment, scaling, and operations of our application stack on DigitalOcean — Droplets, App Platform, Managed Databases (Postgres, Redis), Spaces, VPCs, and load balancers.

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar) for automated testing, deployment, and rollback.

Containerize services with Docker; manage configuration, secrets, and environment promotion across dev/staging/prod.

Implement observability: structured logging, metrics, request tracing, and AI-specific telemetry (token usage, latency, eval scores, cost per tenant).

Maintain backup, disaster recovery, and security baselines for production workloads.

Harden services for the realities of running customer-data-handling apps: TLS, secret rotation, dependency hygiene, and least-privilege IAM.



Integration with MSP & Microsoft 365 Workflows



Build integrations against the Microsoft Graph and Google Workspace Admin SDK to power AI features over real tenant data — mailboxes, drives, identities, devices, and policies.

Develop and maintain PowerShell components where Microsoft tooling demands it, and bridge cleanly back to the main backend.

Support T3's product work (including T3nant Wiz) and internal MSP delivery tooling with shared services and libraries.

Work with the rest of the team to identify high-leverage automation opportunities and ship them.



Engineering Discipline



Write clean, tested, reviewed code. Treat AI-generated code as a draft to be read, not output to be trusted.

Maintain meaningful test coverage — unit, integration, and AI-output evals.

Participate in code review, design discussions, and post-i
 reviews.

Document architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures so the team can support what you build.





Availability & Support Expectations



Standard working hours are 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST.

Some flexibility is required for production deployments, i
 response, or critical client work outside normal hours.

This role is not on-call, but responsiveness during critical events is expected.





Qualifications

Required Experience



5+ years of hands-on backend or full-stack engineering experience shipping production applications.

Demonstrable production experience building applications on the Anthropic API or directly comparable LLM APIs (OpenAI, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock). You should be able to walk us through real systems you've built — tool-use loops, streaming UIs, evals, cost optimizations, and the trade-offs behind each.

Strong Python or Node.js/TypeScript for backend service development.

Solid PostgreSQL experience: schema design, query tuning, migrations, multi-tenant patterns.

Production experience deploying and operating services on DigitalOcean (or directly comparable IaaS — AWS, Azure, GCP, Linode, Hetzner).

Strong Linux, shell, and command-line fluency.

Solid Git and modern software engineering hygiene (PRs, code review, CI/CD, testing).

Working knowledge of HTTP, REST, OAuth 2.0, and webhook patterns.

Excellent native-level English communication skills, both written and verbal.



Strongly Preferred



Hands-on experience with prompt caching, batch API, tool use, and the Files API in production.

Experience building or evaluating AI evals in production environments.

Experience with the Microsoft Graph and/or Google Workspace Admin SDK.

PowerShell proficiency for Microsoft 365 administration.

Experience with Docker, GitHub Actions, and modern deployment tooling.

Familiarity with MSP platforms (SuperOps, Hudu, ConnectWise, Datto, or similar).

Prior experience handling customer data under compliance frameworks (CMMC, HIPAA, SOC 2).

A public GitHub presence or portfolio of AI applications you can share.



How You Work



You read AI output critically. You don't ship code you haven't understood.

You think about cost, latency, and failure modes from day one — not as an afterthought.

You're comfortable saying "this shouldn't be AI" when that's the right call.

You can drop into an unfamiliar codebase or API and get useful work done without hand-holding.





A few notes:



I left in the M365/Graph integration emphasis because that's clearly where T3's domain value is — pull it back if this person is mostly building T3nant Wiz product features and you want a different hire for MSP delivery tooling.

"AI Application Engineer" is the cleanest title for SEO and candidate filtering. "Senior AI Engineer" or "Senior Backend Engineer (AI)" also work.

You want someone who's a skilled Claude Code operator — strong taste, strong judgment, strong communication with the model — not someone who's going to hand-roll a React frontend or argue about ORM choices.
