title: Looking for a savvy, culturally fluent Reddit/Community Mentions Specialist
description:
Job Description: Reddit/Community Mentions Specialist



Job Overview

We are looking for a savvy, culturally fluent Reddit/Community Mentions Specialist to join our marketing and brand reputation team. In this role, you will be the eyes, ears, and voice of our brand across Reddit, Quora, and other niche online forums.



This isn't about traditional customer service or spamming links; it’s about authentic engagement. You will find relevant conversations, provide genuine value to users, subtly insert our brand where appropriate, and protect our reputation in the digital spaces where our audience naturally hangs out.



Key Responsibilities

1. Active Monitoring & Listening



Monitor mentions of our brand, competitors, and industry keywords, can utilize social listening tools (e.g., Brand24, Mention, Awario, or Reddit-specific trackers)

Track sentiment and identify emerging trends, pain points, or viral discussions within relevant subreddits and forums.



2. Authentic Engagement & Advocacy



Participate daily in relevant discussions on Reddit, Quora, 
, and other niche communities.

Own the monthly delivery KPI for naturally placed client brand mentions across Reddit, Quora, and other relevant online communities.

Deliver approximately 50 approved brand mentions per month across all active clients, with volume adjusted based on client scope, quality standards, and available opportunities.



Brand mentions may be delivered through a mixture of original posts, comments, answers, and other relevant community placements, depending on what feels most natural for each platform and conversation.

Provide helpful, high-quality, and objective answers to user questions, establishing yourself as a trusted community member.

Subtly and organically introduce the relevant client’s product or service only when it genuinely adds value to the conversation.



Manage multiple personas/accounts carefully and ethically, while following the specific rules, tone, and netiquette of each subreddit or community.

Identify and complete additional signal/linking opportunities where relevant, including Quora answers, niche foru
ntions, directory submissions, and other community-based visibility opportunities.

Track every opportunity from discovery to placement, including client, platform, thread/page URL, status, live link, removal risk, account used, and notes.



Escalate blockers early when KPI delivery is at risk due to moderation rules, account limitations, lack of relevant threads, or client-fit issues.



3. Crisis Management & Feedback Loop



Identify negative sentiment, misinformation, or customer complaints early and de-escalate them constructively.

Act as the bridge between online communities and our product/marketing teams, relaying valuable user feedback, feature requests, and competitor insights.

Escalate blockers early when KPI delivery is at risk due to moderation rules, account limitations, lack of relevant threads, or client-fit issues.



4. Strategy & Reporting



Collaborate with the SEO and Content teams to identify high-intent threads that can drive qualified referral traffic.

Track key performance metrics, including comment upvotes, reach, referral traffic, and sentiment shifts, providing weekly/monthly reports to management.



Skills and Qualifications

Minimum Requirements



Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Social Media Management, Community Management, or Digital Marketing.

Reddit Fluency: A deep, native understanding of Reddit culture, 
s, formatting, karma systems, and strict subreddit moderation rules.

Writing Excellence: Exceptional written English skills with the ability to adapt your tone—ranging from highly technical and authoritative to casual and conversational.

Thick Skin & Tact: Ability to handle internet trolls, skepticism, and negative feedback with grace, humor, and professionalism.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience using social listening and monitoring software.

Basic understanding of SEO and how forum backlinks/mentions impact search visibility.

An active personal Reddit account with a healthy history of karma and community participation (highly preferred).



What We Offer

Compensation: Commensurate to experience

Remote-first: Work from anywhere in the world

Flexible work environment with supportive team culture



Opportunity to work with innovative SaaS brands

Clear growth paths and skill development opportunities

Transparent, goal-driven workflows



HOW TO APPLY



Submission Requirements (Mandatory)



At MADX, we prioritize clear communication and the ability to follow technical specifications. To ensure your application is processed, you must follow these naming conventions when applying:



Apply through this link: 



Role: Reddit/Community Mentions Specialist

Start your cover letter with the word 'Dominator'

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief cover letter explaining why they are a good fit for this role.



Ensure you follow the mandatory requirements above.

Selected candidates will be invited for an interview to discuss their experience and suitability for the role.

title: AI Automation & Systems Builder
description:
# AI Automation & Systems Builder



We are looking for a hungry, self-motivated AI Automation & Systems Builder based in the Philippines.



This is not a basic virtual assistant job. We are looking for someone who can help us build systems, dashboards, automations, and better workflows that make the company run faster, smarter, and more organized.



You do not need to have a formal technical background, but you must be comfortable learning new tools, figuring things out, testing ideas, and improving systems.



We are looking for someone who is excited to build, not just follow instructions.



## What You’ll Help Build



You may help us with projects such as:



* A company dashboard to track important business information, open issues, tasks, orders, and team performance

* A reorder dashboard that shows which products are running low, what needs to be reordered, what is already on order, supplier follow-up status, estimated arrival dates, and urgent priority items

* Automations between different tools, forms,
s, spreadsheets, websites, and internal systems

* Customer service workflows that help us track issues, questions, follow-ups, and resolutions

* A customer interactive proofing system where customers can review proofs, approve them, request changes, and track status

* Internal systems to reduce manual work and prevent things from falling through the cracks

* Workflows using Codex or other AI coding tools

* Better SOPs, checklists, and tracking systems

* Reports and dashboards that help us see what needs attention quickly



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Hungry to grow

* Self-motivated

* Curious

* Resourceful

* Organized

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable using AI tools

* Comfortable learning new software and systems

* Good at solving problems

* Willing to test, fail, fix, and improve

* Able to follow up without being chased

* Able to communicate clearly

* Honest about what they know and what they still need to learn

* The kind of person who takes ownership and keeps going until the work is done properly



We do not need someone who knows everything already.



We need someone who can think, learn, test, follow up, and find a way.



## Helpful Skills



These skills are helpful, but you do not need to have all of them:



* ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or other AI tools

* Codex or AI coding tools

* Excel or Google Sheets

* Dashboards and reports

* Zapier, Make, Airtable, or similar automation tools

* Google Forms, Typeform, Jotform, or similar form tools

* Apps Script or basic coding

* Customer service systems

* Ecommerce systems

* SOP creation

* Data organization

* Project tracking tools



A technical background is helpful, but not required. What matters more is that you are a strong problem-solver, comfortable learning new tools, and excited to build systems that make the company run better.



## Important Application Rule



Do not use AI to answer this application.



This job requires AI skills, but your application must come from you. I want to see your real thinking, real experience, and real personality.



If your answers sound generic, overly polished, or like they were copied from ChatGPT, your application will be skipped.



Answer honestly and specifically. Short, real, clear answers are better than long AI-written answers.



## Follow-Up Requirement



If you want this job, you must follow up after applying.



We may not answer your first message right away. We are looking for someone who is hungry, takes initiative, and does not wait around passively.



After you apply, send a follow-up message explaining why you believe you are the right person for this role and what you would be excited to help build for our company.



A strong follow-up will make your application stand out.



## To Apply



Please answer the questions below carefully.



Applications with vague, lazy, or generic answers will not be considered.





# Application Questions



Please answer these yourself. Do not use AI to write your answers.



1. Why do you want this job?



2. Why do you think you are the right person for this role?



3. What does being “hungry” in a job mean to you?



4. Tell me about a time you cared so much about finishing a project that you pushed yourself harder than expected. What was the project, what happened, and how did it turn out?



5. Tell me about a time there was an urgent deadline and the work was not finished yet. What did you personally do?



6. When you are working on a project and you realize it will take longer than expected, what do you usually do? Give a real example.



7. What was the last project you became a little obsessed with finishing? Why did it matter to you?

title: Virtual Assistant - Operations, Systems, Growth (Gaming Startup)
description:
**About us**



We're a small, fast-moving team in the video game industry. We're growing quickly, we treat our people well, and we play the long game: clear expectations, steady work, genuine respect, and real growth for those who earn it. This is a seat to build a career in, not a churn-and-burn gig. We're looking for someone exceptional to grow with us.



**What this role is**



You'll be the right hand to seasoned founders who move fast and never run out of ideas, which is exactly why this role exists. Your job is to bring order to that: take things off the plate, build the systems that keep the business running, and turn loose goals into finished work.



Sometimes you'll have a clear process to follow. Just as often, you won't, and that's where the right person shines. When there's no playbook, you research it, figure out the smartest way to do it, talk it through with the founders, build the process, and then act on it.



A real example of what we mean:



"We need to bring on a video editor. Figure out where to find good ones, what it should cost, screen the candidates, bring me your top picks, and once we approve, get them onboarded and working."



That's the level of ownership we're after. We want to hand you a goal and trust it's handled, not assign you a checklist. If you bring problems wrapped in solutions instead of just questions, you'll thrive here. 



If you need step-by-step instructions for everything, this isn't the fit.



We'll have a short check-in call once a day during the initial period to stay aligned, get you up to speed on how we work, unblock you quickly, and move quickly together.



 **What you'll do**



It varies week to week, but expect a mix of:



- Building SOPs and systems: Turning the things we do into clean, written, repeatable processes so the business runs more smoothly over time. This is a core part of the job, not an afterthought.  

- Acting on those systems: Running and following up on recurring work so nothing slips, and keeping our internal systems tidy and up to date.  

- Project management: Owning one-off projects end-to-end: scoping them, driving them, and reporting back clearly.  

- Hiring support: Sourcing, screening, and helping onboard contractors and tea
mbers as we grow.  

- Content posting: Publishing and organizing content across our channels on a consistent schedule.  

- Coordination: Working with vendors, contractors, and our team to keep things moving.  

- Research: Figuring out the best way to do something we've never done, then bringing back a clear recommendation.



The specific tools and tasks are learnable, and we'll teach you what's specific to us. What we can't teach is the resourcefulness and drive to own the outcome.



**Who you are**



- Resourceful: When you hit something you don't know, you figure it out. You research, you learn, and you come back with a plan, not just a question.  

- Proactive and ownership-driven: You anticipate what's needed, follow through without reminders, and treat the business as if it were your own.  

- Organized and systems-minded: You think in processes and checklists. You like building order out of chaos and enjoy finding smarter ways to do things.  

- Comfortable with ambiguity: A sharp, fast learner who can take a vague goal and find the path forward.  

- An excellent communicator: in written and spoken English, clear, professional, and easy to work with. You'll talk to the founders directly and represent us with vendors and contractors.  

- Hungry, with high standards and a strong work ethic: This matters to us more than your résumé. You take pride in your work, and you don't cut corners.  

- Honest, discreet, and trustworthy: You'll handle sensitive information.



**Nice to have**



These are bonuses, not requirements. Tell us if you have any of them:



- 2+ years supporting founders, executives, or businesses  

- Fluent with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. We love people who use them to move faster  

- Experience with Google Workspace, Notion, Trello, or similar  

- Experience writing SOPs or documenting processes  

- Hiring or recruiting experience  

- Content creation or light video editing



**The details**



- Hours: Full-time, with some daily overlap with British Summer Time. We'll work out the exact hours together.  

- Pay: 40,000 PHP  

- Payment: Weekly or biweekly via PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, or similar.  

- Location: Fully remote, work from home.  

- Type: Long-term. We want someone to build a future with us, and strong performers grow quickly from here.



**How to apply**



Please don't send copy-pasted applications. We read every complete one, and generic ones get ignored. One step:



Record a short Loom or YouTube video (a few minutes, on your own time) telling us:  



   - A quick introduction about yourself and your relevant experience  

   - Do you have any experience with video games? If so, which games do you play?  

   - A time you were handed something with little or no instruction, and you figured it out and got it done  

   - Why this role excites you and what makes you the person we're looking for



We reply to every application that's a fit. We're excited to meet you.

title: Remote Practice Manager – Australian Accounting Firm Experience Required
description:
We are looking for a Remote Practice Manager, who has worked in a fast-moving Australian accounting firm and understands the rhythm of compliance work, client follow-ups, workflow, deadlines and practice operations.



This role suits someone who enjoys keeping jobs moving, supporting accountants and admin staff, improving systems, and helping create a smooth and professional client experience.



About the Role



As the Remote Practice Manager, you will be the operational backbone of our accounting, taxation and finance business. You will oversee workflow, monitor job progress, follow up staff and clients, support the Director, and ensure our accountants and bookkeepers can focus on completing quality work.



You will help create a culture of accountability, client care, timely follow-up and continuous improvement.



This is not a basic VA role. 



We need someone who can take ownership, identify bottlenecks, escalate issues early and keep the practice moving without waiting for constant instructions.



Key Responsibilities



Manage day-to-day practice operations remotely

Oversee workflow management, job allocation and turnaround times

Monitor Zoho Desk tickets, job statuses and due dates

Follow up staff on outstanding tasks and overdue jobs

Follow up clients for missing documents, signing, approvals and payments

Monitor jobs waiting for bookkeeping, accountant review, final review and client response

Streamline systems and processes to improve efficiency and profitability

Support the Director with planning, reporting and operational execution

Help admin, accountants, bookkeepers and reviewers stay accountable

Oversee onboarding of new clients and help maintain a smooth client service journey

Ensure the team is using systems properly and keeping job notes updated

Monitor unpaid invoices and provide payment follow-up reports

Identify workflow bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements

Prepare daily or weekly practice reports for the Director

Support marketing follow-through, including Google reviews, lead lists and social media activity

Ensure ATO, BAS, tax return, ASIC and regulatory deadlines are monitored and followed up



What You Bring



Previous experience working with an Australian accounting firm is essential

Experience in practice management, workflow coordination, senior admin, client services or operations

Understanding of how Australian accounting and bookkeeping firms operate

Strong knowledge of tax return, BAS, bookkeeping, financial statement and client document workflow

Strong organisational and workflow management skills

Comfortable managing people, deadlines and competing priorities

Confident written communication with a client-first approach

Ability to follow up staff and clients professionally

Ability to analyse workflow, spot bottlenecks and suggest practical improvements

A calm, solutions-focused style with the ability to keep the practice moving forward

Ability to work independently and report clearly to the Director

Software Experience Preferred



Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:



Zoho Desk

Xero Practice Manager

Karbon

FYI Docs

MYOB AE / AO

Xero

QuickBooks

BGL / SMSF software

ATO Portal exposure

ASIC portal exposure

Microsoft Outlook

Microsoft Teams

Google Sheets

ChatGPT / AI tools

CRM or workflow systems

Work Arrangement

Remote role

Part-time to start

Approximately 20 hours per week

Must be available during Australian business hours

Long-term opportunity for the right person

Opportunity to grow into a larger management role



Rate



AUD $9–$11 per hour, depending on experience.



Rate may be reviewed after 60–90 days based on reliability, ownership, communication, workflow control and ability to manage the role independently.



Important



Please do not apply if you have not worked with an Australian accounting firm before.



We are looking for someone who understands accounting practice workflow and can help manage jobs, people, clients, payments and deadlines with confidence.



This role is for someone who can take ownership of practice operations and help the Director run the business more efficiently.



To Apply



Please send:



Your resume

Details of your previous experience with Australian accounting firms

The systems and software you have used

The type of workflow you managed, such as tax returns, BAS, bookkeeping, financials, SMSF, ASIC or document chasing

Your expected hourly rate in AUD

Your availability during Australian business hours



Please also answer this question:



Tell us about your previous role with an Australian accounting firm and how you helped manage workflow, client follow-ups, document chasing, job deadlines, staff coordination and practice efficiency.

title: Executive & Personal Assistant to the CEO
description:
I am the founder and CEO of two active businesses WavyStay LLC, a short-term rental co-hosting and property management company operating across the US, and Curtis Federal Solutions LLC, a federal prime contracting firm. I also work a full-time government role while building toward full entrepreneurial independence.



My days are full. Between clients, tea
mbers, federal contracts, travel, and a personal life I actually want to enjoy, I need a sharp, proactive right hand who can create space for me to operate at my highest level.



This is not a basic admin role. I need someone who thinks ahead, moves fast, and protects my time like it belongs to them.



WHO YOU ARE



You are organized in a way most people are not. You anticipate what is needed before being asked. You communicate clearly and professionally on behalf of a CEO without sounding like a robot. You handle sensitive information with discretion. You do not need hand-holding. When something falls through a crack, you catch it not me.



If you have supported a founder, entrepreneur, or executive who runs multiple businesses simultaneously, this role was built for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



CALENDAR & SCHEDULING

- Own my full calendar across all three verticals: WavyStay, Curtis Federal Solutions, and my personal life 

- Schedule, confirm, and prep me for all meetings, calls, and appointments

- Block time for deep work, travel, workouts, and personal commitments

- Send reminders and briefing notes before every meeting so I show up prepared



COMMUNICATIONS & INBOX MANAGEMENT

- Monitor and triage my
 inbox  flag urgent, draft responses, archive noise

- Draft professional
s, follow-ups, and client communications on my behalf

- Serve as the first point of contact between me, my team, and clients

- Route messages to the right tea
mber (WavyStay ops, federal BD, etc.) so I am not the bottleneck



CLIENT & TEAM COORDINATION

- Keep client deliverables, follow-ups, and check-ins on track

- Follow up with tea
mbers on outstanding tasks and report back to me

- Coordinate onboarding touchpoints for new WavyStay clients

- Track action items fro
etings and make sure nothing gets dropped



TRAVEL & LIFESTYLE COORDINATION

- Research and book flights, hotels, rental cars, and accommodations

- Build itineraries for business and personal travel

- Coordinate fitness appointments, personal errands, and scheduling around my lifestyle

- Research restaurants, experiences, and reservations when needed



BUSINESS OPERATIONS SUPPORT

- Maintain and organize Google Drive, Mondaycom, Go High Level, Notion, or shared file systems

- Track deadlines across active projects and flag anything at risk

- Prepare documents, proposals, and presentations when needed

- Run research tasks and summarize findings so I can make fast decisions



WHAT YOU NEED



- 2–4 years of experience as an executive assistant, personal assistant, or chief of staff support role

- Experience supporting a founder or business owner with multiple active projects

- Excellent written English — you will be writing on behalf of a CEO

- Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs)

- Strong organizational systems and the ability to manage competing priorities without dropping the ball

- Comfortable handling personal scheduling alongside business tasks

- Discreet with confidential business and personal information

- Available 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend responsiveness



BONUS POINTS

- Experience supporting a real estate, STR, or property management business

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Notion, or project management tools

- Prior experience managing communications for a US-based executive



COMPENSATION



Base salary: $500–$1,000/month USD depending on experience with bonuses and commissions 

Performance review at 90 days with raise potential for the right person

Long-term opportunity: This role grows as I grow. Top performers move into Chief of Staff territory.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a template. I will not read it.



Send me all three of the following:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile link

2. A 2–3 minute video introduction — tell me who you are, the most complex executive you have supported, and one example of a time you caught something before it became a problem

3. Answer this question in writing: "A client
s asking for an update on their onboarding. I haven't given you any context yet. How do you handle it?"



All three items are required. Missing any one of the
ans your application will not be reviewed. This is not a test of perfection it is a test of whether you follow instructions and think on your feet.



I am looking for someone I can trust with my calendar, my clients, and my peace of mind. If that is you, I want to hear from you.



— Ron Curtis (Wavy)

Founder, WavyStay LLC | Curtis Federal Solutions LLC
